test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The environmental organisation issued a statement to __condemn__ the deforestation happening in the protected area.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the word 'condemn' is used to express strong disapproval.
 
• The word **'Censure'** also means **to express strong disapproval or criticism, making it the most appropriate synonym.**
 
 
• Mr. Wilson disappoints and offers gossip,** censure** and critical summary
 
 

Hence, the correct synonym for** 'condemn' is 'censure.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Other options provided do not convey the same meaning:

 
• **Persuade:** To convince someone to do something.
 
• **Foster:** To encourage or promote the development of something.
 
• **Compel:** To force or oblige someone to do something.
